question.text: In case of heteronuclear diatomics of the type $A B,$ where $A$ is more electronegative than $B$, bonding molecular orbital resembles the character of $A$ more than that of $B$. The statement

options.text: cannot be evaluated since data is not sufficient
is true only for centain systems

solution.text: The given statement is true as electrons are shifted more towards the more electronegative atom.
